_comment: faithdiff suppression list — GLOBAL translation boundaries only (symbols that
legitimately appear on one side of every routine). Routine-specific divergences
(a dropped PlayCry, a substituted helper) must stay visible: they are the report.
Each entry carries its why; --all-hits shows suppressed items.

calls.DelayFrame: port frame-pipeline plumbing (present/OAM-DMA per frame); pret's DelayFrame placement differs across the video boundary
calls.DumpBackbuffer: DEBUG_* harness dump hook, %ifdef-gated, not game logic
calls.perf_evt_begin: DEBUG_PERF event-recorder hook (perf.asm timing DEVIATION), %ifdef-gated, not game logic
calls.perf_evt_lap: DEBUG_PERF event-recorder hook (perf.asm timing DEVIATION), %ifdef-gated, not game logic
calls.perf_evt_commit: DEBUG_PERF event-recorder hook (perf.asm timing DEVIATION), %ifdef-gated, not game logic
calls.hide_window: port window-compositor HAL boundary (GB hides the window via LCDC writes — TODO-HW)
calls.Bankswitch: GB ROM banking does not exist in the flat 32-bit port

stores.hSCX: renderer scroll plumbing — pret writes rSCX via HRAM+ISR (TODO-HW boundary)
stores.hSCY: renderer scroll plumbing — pret writes rSCY via HRAM+ISR (TODO-HW boundary)
stores.hLoadedROMBank: GB ROM banking does not exist in the port
stores.hSPTemp: GB stack-pointer save for pop-de VRAM transfer; x86 port uses flat rep movsb
stores.CC: the cable-club/trade projected-coordinate macro CC(x,y) — the X+10 Y+3 canvas transform (cable_club.asm header projection DEVIATION), not a WRAM symbol; ldcoord_a-style stores are spelled mov [ebp + CC(x,y)] so the port store scanner captures the macro NAME on every screen routine of the area
